messages.text: Saturday, October 17 · Canton, Michigan
Partly cloudy skies, a data center decision, and a night of scenes

A partly cloudy Saturday offers a cool high of 48°F. The day's local focus is on the Van Buren Township's decision regarding a large Google data center, while science news explores social anxiety and herbicide effects on weeds.
Expect partly cloudy skies today with a high near 48°F and a low around 34°F, with a 1% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:49 AM and sunset is at 6:49 PM, with the moon in its First Quarter phase, 36.8% illuminated.
Evening events to consider

For live theater, consider the "Evening of Scenes" at East Quadrangle - Keene Theater in Ann Arbor at 8:00 PM, which is free. Alternatively, "THEATRE l I'd Love to Have You for Dinner" in Hamtramck offers a psychological thriller at 8:00 PM for $27.6.
Mark your calendar for the 862 Meeting on October 21st.
Van Buren Township approves Google data center plan

The Van Buren Township Planning Commission has approved the final site plan for the Project Cannoli Data Center, developed by Panattoni for Google. Preliminary construction has begun on the 282-acre site.
Tomorrow and the days ahead
Tomorrow brings the first quarter moon phase. Looking further out, the Orionids meteor shower is nearing its peak on October 21st.

Sunday, October 18 · Canton, Michigan
Autumn clarity, a data center decision, and brain sensitivity

Expect a mostly clear and comfortably cool autumn day. The most consequential local news involves a recent decision on a large data center, while science offers insights into social anxiety and weed resilience.
The day will be mostly clear with a high near 58°F and a low around 36°F, with no chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:50 AM and sunset is at 6:47 PM, with the moon 46.1% illuminated during its first quarter phase.
Ann Arbor's creative and sonic offerings

This Thursday, explore Ann Arbor's upcoming events: the Creative Reuse at the Lab Swap Shop at 1 PM offers artistic exploration with surplus lab supplies, and the 3rd Spaceout International Ambisonics Festival at 7 PM showcases spatial audio performances.
Mark your calendar for the 862 Meeting on Wednesday evening.
Van Buren Township approves Project Cannoli Data Center plan

The Van Buren Township Planning Commission has approved the final site plan for the Project Cannoli Data Center, developed by Panattoni for Google. Preliminary construction has begun on the 282-acre site.
Upcoming events in Ann Arbor
Later this week, consider the "Best of FAMU" film screening on Thursday evening and a workshop on creative reuse of lab supplies.
